static_observations: SourcePointInterner::issue hashes complete immutable payload only to choose a bucket; issue_in_bucket compares complete payload equality before returning an existing key.

Payload equality includes the exact OriginalSourceAnalysisOwner Arc identity, full input, source/site/words/path, full SourceLookupSnapshot equality, and namespace. SourceLookupSnapshot equality compares full state and realm; no new fingerprint-only or owner-only shortcut was introduced.

Production issuance uses a single private global interner. checked_add refuses fresh allocation at u64::MAX after first allowing reuse of an existing live equal receipt. Retired keys are never recycled.

Entry Eq/Hash/Ord use the issued key consistently. Origin token contains only that immutable key and cannot independently access state. SourceOriginKind still includes exact child SourceImage and full semantic origin equality beyond its cached fingerprint.

Strong payload retains parent analysis owner and snapshot; options, SourceAnalysisEntry, source cache key, child baseline, inherited call receipt and retained CU carry entry clones. Ancestor state is retained through prior entry chain.

matches_parent_analysis checks exact retained owner pointer, full input/config/image and source realm. It deliberately does not certify physical publication currentness. Independent byte-equal B cannot match A; a clone of the retained same A can.
Derived source graph memo is outside semantic Eq/Hash and releases its table mutex before recursive preparation. No payload-to-self graph ownership cycle was identified statically.
